description.en: Checks every goal's done_when against evidence, detects intent drift, stages knowledge candidates and updates project life.
description.ru: Сверяет каждую цель done_when с доказательствами, ловит дрейф намерения, кладёт кандидатов знаний на стейджинг и обновляет жизнь проекта.

proof_currency.note: git: какие записанные доказательства ещё покрывают код, а какие устарели (машина считает перед аудитом)

nodes.prompt:
For each goal check `done_when` against evidence (command output, file:line, test result); met only with evidence you re-checked now.
`proof_currency`, when given, is git's own verdict on whether each recorded proof still covers the code: use it, do not work currency out from git by hand. A proof marked STALE, NOT ON THIS HISTORY or UNKNOWN COMMIT is not current evidence: re-check that goal on the code as it is now and name the changed paths in the evidence.
intent_aligned=false when the result drifts from the original goal: two or more in_scope items missing or one out_of_scope item violated (confident drift at 80%+).
Different model from the writer. Never ask the owner for what the repository can answer.

Stage candidates only, never publish. Keep decisions, locked constraints and lessons; drop process narration and what the code already says.
confidence = +0.3 locked or explicit decision, +0.2 three or more keywords, +0.2 rationale, +0.2 length 50-2000, +0.1 reference; threshold 0.5.
Publication needs the owner's explicit approval; no answer means deferred. An auto mode is not approval.

Update the project's life files from what this run delivered (the merged commits, the audit report, the staged knowledge): .agents/PROGRESS.md, CHANGELOG.md, plans/ and todos/ entries. Touch nothing else; status no_change when there is nothing to record.
